title: ads.changes/1
description: Each change made on an ad platform: when, what, and who or which kind of client made it. measurement reads it to keep a change from being mistaken for an effect.
x-rules: A change is written once; a later document repeats it with the same change_id and never alters it.
A change the operator did not make (a person in the platform's own screen, the platform's rule) is still listed when the operator can read it, with by_kind saying so.
An absent optional key means unknown, never null and never an empty string.

producer.description: The pack that wrote the document (its CLI word).

produced_at.description: When the document was written: ISO 8601 with its zone.

changes.description: The changes, oldest first; empty when there are none.

change_id.description: Unique and stable: the same change has the same id in every document that lists it.

at.description: When the change took effect: ISO 8601 with its zone.

platform.description: The platform the change was made on (the operator's platform id).

entity_kind.description: What was changed: campaign, ad_group, ad, creative, budget or another word the platform uses.

entity_id.description: The changed entity's id on the platform, as text.

what.description: What kind of change: budget, bid, status, targeting, schedule, creative or another word; the operator's own.

by_kind.description: Who made it: a person, this pack's agent, the platform's own rule, or not known.

by.description: The person's or agent's name or id, when the platform gives one.

client_type.description: Which kind of client made it, when the platform says: api, web, app or another word.
